data.description: Burj Khalifa View | Corner Unit | Near Metro
data.long_description:
This stunning 2-bedroom apartment has the absolute WOW factor, the living/dining area features floor to ceiling panoramic windows with views of Burj Khalifa and the Sheikh Zayed Road Sky line (corner unit). See Sheikh Zayed Road light up at sunset from your wrap around balcony.

Both bedrooms are ensuite and there is a separate powder room for your guests, offering privacy and convenience.

1 Residences is only 200 meters walk from Zabeel Park, enjoy you a morning run in the park or an evening stroll after work. It is only a 10 min drive to the Dubai Mall and a 15 min drive to DXB airport.

The apartment:

- 2 bedroom (Tower 1/West Tower)
- Burj Khalifa/ Sheih Zayed Road
- Above 20th floor
- 1,507 sq.ft (140 sq.m)
- Both Bedrooms are ensuite
- Powder room
- Laundry Room
- Extra storage room
- Wooden floors
- Wrap around balcony 

200 meter walk from Zabeel Park & Dubai Frame (2 minutes)
10 min drive to the Dubai Mall
15 min drive to DXB Airport
17 min drive to La Mer Beach

Amenities:

Pool and state of the art gym
Kids pool and play area
Hotel style reception lobby on ground level
200 meter walk from Zabeel Park (2 minutes)

Neighborhood shops:
